19 The full recapitalization of both RBB and NBL was specifically recommended by the FSAP (FSAP Technical Note on] State-Controlled Banks) and in multiple IMF Article IV reports. The decision to resolve RBB and NBL on an open basis
was made more than a decade ago and attempting to revisit the resolution approach at this point in time - when the banks
are profitable and, in RBB's case fully capitalized and NBL's well on the way to full recapitalization - would pose a
significant risk of undermining public confidence in the policy reform measures taken so far. There is also now no legal

basis for attempting to close NBL.
